text: Run AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions, started with a single API call
quote: Hyperbrowser lets you run powerful, AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions... you can start tasks with a single API call and watch them execute live.

text: Watch agent tasks execute live as they run
quote: Hyperbrowser lets you run powerful, AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions... you can start tasks with a single API call and watch them execute live.

text: Give the browser natural-language instructions (e.g. page.ai) to complete multi-step tasks like searching and selecting flights
quote: await page.ai("search for flights from Miami to LAX, select the cheapest option");

text: Extract structured data from pages using natural language with optional Zod schema validation
quote: The `page.extract()` method pulls structured data from web pages. Define what you want using natural language and optionally enforce a schema with Zod for type-safe results.

text: Stealth mode applies anti-detection techniques to bypass bot detection
quote: Stealth mode applies anti-detection techniques to help your automated browser sessions bypass bot detection.

text: Automatically detect and solve CAPTCHAs when enabled at session creation
quote: Hyperbrowser can automatically detect and solve CAPTCHAs when you enable it during session creation.

text: Save and reuse browser profiles (cookies, local/session storage, cache) across sessions
quote: Profiles let you save and reuse browser state, which includes cookies, local storage, session storage, and cache, across multiple sessions.

text: Record sessions as lightweight rrweb web recordings or traditional MP4 video for sharing
quote: Hyperbrowser supports both web recordings (using rrweb) that capture DOM changes and interactions in a lightweight format, and traditional MP4 video recordings for easy sharing.

text: Official MCP server exposes web automation (scraping, extraction, crawling) as standardized tools for AI models
quote: The Hyperbrowser MCP server provides a standardized interface for AI models to access powerful web automation capabilities like scraping, structured extraction, and crawling.

text: scrape_webpage tool extracts formatted content (markdown, screenshots) from any webpage
quote: `scrape_webpage` - Extract formatted (markdown, screenshot etc) content from any webpage

text: Connect existing automation scripts to Hyperbrowser's cloud browsers
quote: Connect your existing automation scripts to cloud browsers
